notablePrerequisites: Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Izzet Chronarch.
description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying {8}{U}{U}, taking two extra turns after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Izzet Chronarch.
When the token Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
